explanation: cos θ* = 1.3 exceeds the physical range [-1, 1] for exclusive two-body electroproduction kinematics. The eta-channel EXCLURAD grid also limits |cos θ*| ≤ 0.9. W = 1.7 GeV and Q² = 1.0 GeV² are valid (W > M_p + M_η ≈ 1.486 GeV), φ* = 90° is valid, but the requested cosine of the center-of-mass production angle is impossible and cannot be corrected by a simple rescaling without altering the physics.
